title: Gemstones language-model training trajectories
publisher: Gemstones authors, University of Maryland research team; training at Oak Ridge National Laboratory Frontier
deterministic_selection_rule: Two original trajectory JSONLs, extraction script, README and MIT license at the pinned commit. Source release is already filtered by its authors.

measurement_dates.description: 2025 research release; immutable Git commit 5f420478f6057b0cbb4d13405fb10ca64675bccb. Trajectory execution dates are source fields where present.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Authors extracted, grouped and filtered W&B logs before publication. Their live W&B space is private; the public JSONLs are the provided intermediate release. Model weights, corpora and additional validation collections are not downloaded.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Gemstones, arXiv:2502.06857 / NeurIPS 2025, already fits scaling laws. Source filtering can exclude failed/divergent runs; this collection cannot restore them. Chunks/steps are not independent models.
